_comment: Single source of truth for Gemini model selection. Read by scripts/lib/gemini_models.py and scripts/lib/gemini-models.ts. Verified against https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/models.md.txt and the deprecations page on 2026-09-13.

notes.bulk: Cheap high-volume batch / per-item work. gemini-3.1-flash-lite is stable; shutdown 2027-05-07.
notes.judgment: Reasoning where accuracy matters but volume is still per-item. Same id as bulk today; separate role so the two can diverge without a sweep.
notes.pro: The few sites that need a pro model. gemini-3.1-pro-preview has no announced shutdown date and is the current pro id.
notes.vision: Multimodal extraction from a single file (OCR, charts, tables, video). Kept on a full flash model because flash-lite regresses on dense-document reading.
